about_short_description.short_description: Leveling up gamers with expert coaching, localized content, and tournaments powering the next generation of esports champions.

product.name: PROCODE Competitive Gaming Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for competitive gamers to participate in tournaments, access coaching and learning content, connect with communities, and track performance.

product.name: Tournaments and Competitions
product.description: A competition service offering tournaments, head-to-head duels, seasonal circuits, and multi-tournament events across games such as VALORANT, EA FC, Rocket League, Tekken 8, and others.

product.name: Coaching Services
product.description: A marketplace for booking sessions with verified esports coaches, professional players, and high-rank competitors for training, gameplay reviews, and personalized feedback.

product.name: Community and Player Networking
product.description: Community features that help gamers find teammates, join teams, communicate with players, and participate in a network of creators, streamers, professionals, and community leaders.

product.name: Content Library and Learning
product.description: A learning service containing educational modules, premium content packs, and coaching guides that support player development and competitive gaming knowledge.

product.name: ProToken
product.description: An in-platform points system earned through competition, coaching, learning, and community activity, redeemable for selected PROCODE services and platform benefits.
